rows.note: Use 嚇親 as the all-purpose verb for suddenly frightening someone or being startled.

example.english: That clap of thunder just managed to startle me.
example.jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 go2 seng1 leoi4 haak3 can1 ngo5 laa3

rows.note: Use 嚇一跳 when the startled person's sudden physical reaction or jump is the focus.

example.english: You made me startle when you suddenly tapped me on the shoulder from behind.
example.traditional: 你突然喺後面拍我膊頭，嚇我一跳呀！
example.jyutping: nei5 dat6 jin4 hai2 hau6 min6 paak3 ngo5 bok3 tau4 haak3 ngo5 jat1 tiu3 aa1
